title: console-tooling-standup-2026-08-04
content:
Date: 2026-08-04
Attendees: Maya Chen, Ethan Rivera, Priya Nair, Liam O'Connor, Sofia Martinez, (quick pop-ins: Arjun, Mei)
Location: Zoom (#console-team)

Agenda:
- Quick sync on Console UI tickets and rollouts work
- Analytics dashboard regressions and tracing gaps
- Canary rollout plan for 2.3.0 (feature flags + metrics)
- Blockers / help needed

Yesterday / Updates:
- UI: Completed header refactor (PR #214) - improved render perf on initial load (~15% faster). Ethan landed accessibility fixes for modal focus traps. Found one regression where timepicker loses keyboard focus in Safari (will open bug).
- Rollouts: Priya finished the canary policy draft for A/B + fallback. Staging rollout tests passed for 20k req/day profile. Documented rollout metrics to watch (latency p50/p95, error-rate, user-facing trace id missing). Linked doc in Confluence.
- Analytics: Liam pushed a hotfix for missing event batching that caused undercounting of route-open events. Temporary workaround is live; root cause traced to batch flush race on low-traffic nodes.
- Observability: Added additional trace_id propagation in the frontend instrumentation - initial checks good, but still seeing some sessions without trace.

Today / Plans:
- Maya: Pair with infra on tracing gaps, run end-to-end trace tests across regional deployments. Follow up on SRE ticket CONSOLE-721 to confirm header propagation.
- Ethan: Create Safari patch for timepicker focus bug and open a small PR. Also will add a lightweight integration test for modal focus.
- Priya: Run canary rollout for 2.3.0 to 5% of traffic tomorrow morning, monitor the four primary metrics (latency p50/p95, http 5xx rate, client error rate, analytics-event drop rate). Prepare rollback playbook.
- Liam: Work on deterministic flush for analytics batching; aim to release v0.2.1 hotfix by EOD. Coordinate with Priya to enable extra logging during canary.
- Sofia: Update console dashboard widgets to expose the new rollout metric and add an alert for event-drop > 2%.

Blockers / Help Needed:
- Trace propagation inconsistency: still see ~3% sessions without trace_id. Need a backend engineer to review header passthrough in the gateway (pinged Arjun). Ticket: CONSOLE-721.
- Canary rollout threshold: Ops asked for a safe automated rollback threshold. Need an agreement on metric thresholds (Priya to propose RFC today).
- Analytics undercount: Need product input on whether to backfill missing events for July 28- Aug 2 or mark them as partial. CC: Product analytics team.

Notes / Discussion Highlights:
- We discussed shipping the header refactor as a patch release (2.2.1) vs bundling with 2.3.0. Decision: ship patch for accessibility fixes now; exclude canary/rollout infra changes until 2.3.0 to reduce risk.
- Agree to run a small synthetic load test targeting KV-cache warmup to verify batching behavior at canary scale. Action: Maya + Liam to run test Monday 8/10.
- Priya pointed out we need a dedicated dashboard widget for rollout health; Sofia will prototype using the new metrics API.
- Quick reminder: tie quality regression alerts to the prompt-sets evals for console-generated prompts (avoid silent quality drift when swapping model variants).

Action Items (owners + due dates):
- Ethan: Open Safari timepicker focus PR and add integration test (due 2026-08-05).
- Priya: Publish canary rollout RFC with thresholds and rollback plan (due 2026-08-04 EOD).
- Maya + Liam: Run KV-cache synthetic test and share results (due 2026-08-10).
- Liam: Release analytics v0.2.1 hotfix and add deterministic flush (due 2026-08-04).
- Sofia: Prototype rollout health widget and add alert for event-drop >2% (due 2026-08-06).
- Arjun (SRE): Review header passthrough in gateway and confirm fix (requested, due 2026-08-05).

Open Questions / To follow up:
- Do we backfill July 28- Aug 2 analytics events or mark dataset partial? (Action: product analytics to advise by 8/06)
- Should canary start at 1% or 5% traffic? Ops prefers 1% for cross-region tests; product wants 5% for signal. Priya to include both options in RFC and recommended thresholds.
- Confirm alert routing: should rollout-health alerts go to #console-ops or #sre-oncall? (Ops to decide)

Notes to self / rough TODOs:
- add link to PR that repros trace-less sessions (I/O reproduction steps) - put in CONSOLE-721
- follow up with legal on data retention sidecar for private deployments (Sofia)

Next meeting: weekly standup Monday 2026-08-11 10:00 PT
